description: This file defines a mutable builder class for creating immutable Message instances, providing a fluent API for setting various message properties such as payload, raw payload, extra data, and response consumer.

classes.name: ImmutableMessageBuilder
classes.description: A final, generic builder class for constructing immutable Message objects with a fluent API, supporting setting headers, payload, raw payload, extra data, and response consumer.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new builder instance with specified message headers.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Sets the payload of the message being built.

methods.name: rawPayload
methods.description: Sets the raw payload (ByteBuffer) of the message.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Sets additional JSON data associated with the message.

methods.name: responseConsumer
methods.description: Sets a response consumer to handle responses for the message.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an immutable Message instance with the configured properties.
